The '''''Batil''''' was a [[Gunship/Legends|gunship]] equivalent [[Starship/Legends|starship]] used by the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]] during the [[Second Galactic Civil War]]. They were used in the [[Second Battle of Balmorra]] and the [[Battle of Kuat (Second Galactic Civil War)|Battle of Kuat]].
